name: @wave/mobile-agent
description: Repository-local mobile automation for Radon-managed Expo development builds

scripts.doctor: npm run build --silent && node --enable-source-maps dist/cli.js doctor
scripts.prepare:ios: npm run build --silent && node --enable-source-maps dist/cli.js prepare-ios
scripts.prune:artifacts: npm run build --silent && node --enable-source-maps dist/cli.js prune-artifacts
scripts.reload: npm run build --silent && node --enable-source-maps dist/cli.js reload
scripts.smoke:android: npm run build --silent && node --enable-source-maps dist/cli.js smoke-android
scripts.smoke:observability: npm run build --silent && node --enable-source-maps dist/cli.js smoke-observability
scripts.smoke:ios: npm run build --silent && node --enable-source-maps dist/cli.js smoke-ios
scripts.smoke:production: npm run build --silent && node --enable-source-maps dist/cli.js smoke-production
